infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to find nearby drivers and rental services, calculate trip distances and fares, provide accurate pickup and drop-off points, and enable real-time ride tracking during an active trip. Location data is only accessed while you are using the app.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: We use the microphone to enable voice search. We only listen while you see “Listening…”, and do not store audio.
